name: Suzaki Tatsuya
source: A second year student of Kashima school, Serina's childhood friend and a member of the Kasuga Independent Gang. He's also head over heels in love for Serina. Unlike Teppei, he's a man of intellect, always fighting with Teppei over Serina. He has frameless glasses and is very popular in the school.
